entries.title: Genesis 35:1
segments: And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. And make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.

entries.title: Genesis 35:2
segments: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods among you, and be clean, and change your garments.

entries.title: Genesis 35:3
segments: And let us arise and go up to Bethel, and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

entries.title: Genesis 35:4
segments: And they gave all the strange gods which [were] in their hands to Jacob, and the earrings in their ears. And Jacob hid them under the oak which [was] by Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 35:5
segments: And they moved. And the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 35:6
segments: And Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:7
segments: And he built an altar there and called the place El-bethel, because God appeared to him there when he fled from the face of his brother.

entries.title: Genesis 35:8
segments: But Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried beneath Bethel, under an oak. And the name of it was called Oak of Weeping.

entries.title: Genesis 35:9
segments: And God appeared to Jacob again when he came out of Padan-aram and blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:10
segments: And God said to him, Your name [is] Jacob. Your name shall not be called Jacob any more, but Israel shall be your name. And He called his name Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 35:11
segments: And God said to him, I [am] God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations shall be from you, and kings shall come out of your loins.

entries.title: Genesis 35:12
segments: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you, and to your seed after you I will give the land.

entries.title: Genesis 35:13
segments: And God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:14
segments: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone. And he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.

entries.title: Genesis 35:15
segments: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.

entries.title: Genesis 35:16
segments: And they moved from Bethel. And there was only a length of land to come to Ephrath. And Rachel travailed, and she had hard labor in her bearing.

entries.title: Genesis 35:17
segments: And it happened when she was in hard labor in her bearing, the midwife said to her, Do not fear, you shall have this son also.

entries.title: Genesis 35:18
segments: And it happened as her soul was departing (for she died) that she called his name Benoni. But his father called him Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 35:19
segments: And Rachel died and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

entries.title: Genesis 35:20
segments: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave. That is the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.

entries.title: Genesis 35:21
segments: And Israel moved, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

entries.title: Genesis 35:22
segments: And it happened when Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine. And Israel heard it. And the sons of Jacob were twelve:

entries.title: Genesis 35:23
segments: The sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun.

entries.title: Genesis 35:24
segments: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 35:25
segments: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's slave woman: Dan and Naphtali.

entries.title: Genesis 35:26
segments: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's slave woman: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob born to him in Padan-aram.

entries.title: Genesis 35:27
segments: And Jacob came to his father Isaac, to Mamre, to the city of Arba, which [is] Hebron, where Abraham had lived, and Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 35:28
segments: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.

entries.title: Genesis 35:29
segments: And Isaac expired and died, and was gathered to his people, old and satisfied of days. And his sons, Esau and Jacob, buried him.
